capabilities: add and update literature notes from a bibliography file
export notes to docx with Pandoc citeproc citations
search the Zotero style repository and set CSL properties
copy and export PDFs listed in note properties
remove named YAML properties across literature notes
extras: Citekeys containing # ^ [ ] | \ / : are skipped since Obsidian filenames cannot contain them; BetterBibTeX JSON cannot be used with the Pandoc export feature while Better CSL JSON contains less data unless extended via postscript.
intentEvidence: reinforces the workflow between Zotero and Obsidian
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep literature notes in sync with a Zotero bibliography or to convert wiki-link citations into formatted references when exporting documents.

relations.evidence: reinforces the workflow between Zotero and Obsidian
Requiring the installation of Better Bibtex for Zotero and Pandoc
it is recommended to use Dataview or Bases for setting dynamic templates
if you use Bases (Obsidian's built-in database feature, requires v1.9+) instead of (or alongside) Dataview

summary: Zotero bridge that imports literature notes from a Better BibTeX bibliography file and exports notes to docx via Pandoc citeproc.
